metrics.name: 点击/发送率
metrics.definition: clicked/sent，同一批次与观察窗口；零分母不计算

open_analysis_tool_report.sql: WITH windowed AS (SELECT *,? AS observation_hours FROM metric_push_daily_outcomes) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.clicked_hour<=d.observation_hours AND (d.delivered_hour IS NULL OR d.delivered_hour>d.observation_hours) THEN d.n ELSE 0 END) AS c_click_missing_delivery,SUM(CASE WHEN d.clicked_hour<=d.observation_hours THEN d.n ELSE 0 END) AS c_clicked,SUM(d.n) AS c_sent FROM windowed d WHERE d.sent_day >= ? AND d.sent_day < ? AND d.app_id IN (?) LIMIT 1001
